module.purpose: Traverses React element trees to await unresolved lazy payloads and optionally collect stylesheet URLs for server-side preloading.
module.summary: This module provides a synchronous generator for cycle-safe traversal of React trees and an asynchronous coordinator that waits for pending or blocked lazy component payloads. Traversal deliberately stops at Suspense boundaries, skips React ownership and store metadata, and detects stylesheet link elements injected by the RSC bundler so their URLs can be collected without altering the tree.
module.businessContext: Supports React Server Components navigation by ensuring client chunks are loaded before rendering and enabling CSS preloading. Failure can cause Suspense flashing or missing stylesheet preloads.
functions: findPendingLazyPayloads (~L13-70): Traverses trees, stops at Suspense, collects CSS, and yields lazy payloads.
awaitLazyElements (~L84-95): Sequentially waits for all pending lazy payloads while suppressing rejection.

io: Invokes the optional CSS collector callback for matching stylesheet link elements.

detail.name: findPendingLazyPayloads
preconditions: The optional seen argument, when supplied, supports has and add operations.
The optional cssCollector argument, when supplied, accepts a CSS href string.
postconditions: Each yielded value is a lazy-element payload whose status is pending or blocked and whose then property is a function.
Each object identity is traversed at most once per shared seen set.
Recognized stylesheet links with a truthy href and a cssCollector cause the href to be passed to cssCollector.
invariants: Falsy values and non-object values produce no yields and are not traversed.
Objects already present in seen produce no yields and are not traversed.
The _owner and _store keys are excluded from recursive traversal.
Objects inside recognized Suspense boundaries are not traversed.
edgeCases: A null, undefined, primitive, or other falsy input produces an empty generator result.
A cyclic or multiply referenced object graph is traversed without revisiting an object identity.
A lazy payload with status other than pending or blocked, or without a functional then property, is not yielded.
A stylesheet link without data-rsc-css-href, without a truthy href, or without a cssCollector does not invoke the collector.
An array is traversed item by item; other objects are traversed through enumerable own keys except _owner and _store.
A recognized Suspense element stops traversal at that boundary.

units.name: awaitLazyElements

detail.name: awaitLazyElements
postconditions: All payloads yielded by findPendingLazyPayloads have been awaited before the returned promise fulfills.
The returned promise fulfills with undefined unless findPendingLazyPayloads itself or iteration fails outside an individual payload rejection.
invariants: Payloads are processed in the order yielded by findPendingLazyPayloads.
Each yielded payload is awaited before processing the next payload.
Rejection from an individual payload does not propagate from awaitLazyElements.
edgeCases: When no payloads are yielded, the function completes without awaiting any payload and fulfills with undefined.
When a yielded payload fulfills, processing continues to the next yielded payload.
When a yielded payload rejects, its rejection is swallowed and processing continues with subsequent payloads.

errorPolicy.returnsOnError: Individual yielded payload rejections are ignored; errors thrown by findPendingLazyPayloads or its iteration are not caught by this function.

detail.summary: Discovers pending lazy payloads in a tree and waits for each payload to settle. Payload rejection is swallowed so the returned promise resolves without propagating payload errors.

specTests.then: The returned Promise fulfills with undefined.
